summary: Live e2e backend testing of Compass 3.0 Sprint 1 (functional_v3 engine) via public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Built pytest suite covering (1) session creation + first-turn fixed-mindset invitation, (2) durable-processing placeholder + 409 on concurrent interact, (3) turn-2 revision comparison, and (4) functional_v3_trace.log schema validation. All 3 pytest tests PASSED (43s total). Health endpoint 200 confirms engine import seam intact for canonical_v2 rollback.
verifications_confirmed: POST /api/sessions with reasoning_mode='canonical_v2' returns 200 and persists mode
POST /api/sessions/{id}/interact returns in <2s with role='ai', status='processing' placeholder turn (durable processing)
Second interact while processing rejected with HTTP 409; no duplicate turns created
GET /api/sessions/{id} polling: AI turn reaches status='complete' within 180s for both writing and revise
Turn 1 AI content is a non-empty invitation and does NOT rewrite the paragraph (no 'here is your', 'rewritten version', etc.)
Trace log record: engine='functional_v3', focus_status='sufficient', selected_function='develop' (in allowed set {develop, functional_organization})

functional_decision contains all 14 required schema keys (communicative_task, topic, current_focus, focus_status, functions, functional_organization, naive_reader_need, selected_function, student_facing_term, selected_operation, local_target, developmental_sufficiency, continuity_decision, confidence) — plus focus_reasoning and progress_since_last_turn
Turn 2 (revise) trace: continuity_decision='complete' (in allowed set {hold, advance, recurse, complete}), progress_since_last_turn non-empty string
Turn 2 AI content is non-empty and does not rewrite the paragraph
GET /api/ health returns 200 — canonical_v2 rollback module seam healthy
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 4673 lines — well above the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting reasoning-mode routers, session CRUD, and Experience Compass into modules. Not blocking; noted for maintainability.

Interact endpoint uses fire-and-forget asyncio.create_task(_run_reasoning(...)) without a task registry. If uvicorn worker restarts mid-turn the placeholder AI turn stays 'processing' forever with no recovery/timeout sweeper visible. Consider a startup reaper that fails placeholder turns older than N minutes.

SessionCreate.reasoning_mode has no server-side whitelist (unlike PATCH /reasoning-mode at L2242). A client can send arbitrary strings on POST /api/sessions; the value then drives downstream branching. Minor hardening: validate on create too.
seed_data_creation: One canonical_v2 session created per test run (POST /api/sessions with assignment 'What is the fixed mindset?'). No cleanup — sessions are ephemeral test data; add filter/cleanup if required by ops.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sprint 1 acceptance criteria pass end-to-end on the live preview URL. The test module TestCompass3Sprint1 stashes the session id on request.config for turn-2 chaining, so if you re-run only test_02 in isolation it will skip/fail — run the class as a whole. Trace log at /app/backend/functional_v3_trace.log grows on each turn; use last-line + strip-leading-timestamp-before-'{' to parse. LLM turn latency averaged ~18s per turn in this run (well under the 120s budget).
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found. All Sprint 1 acceptance criteria satisfied.
